description: Redesign review approval panel as a decision-oriented UI with result banner, issue summary, result-dependent actions, full report modal, and optimized send-back logic

tasks.title: Create ReviewSummary component with Result Banner and Issue Summary
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/components/ReviewSummary.tsx` containing: (1) `parseReviewOutput` helper that extracts result, dimensions, reviewReport, selfReviewNotes from `Record<string, unknown>` with safe defaults; (2) `ReviewSummary` component that renders a Result Banner (PASS=green/checkmark, FAIL=red/X, unknown=gray) and Issue Summary (FAIL dimensions as expanded cards with bullet issues, PASS dimensions collapsed to one line). No side effects — pure display component receiving `output` prop.
acceptanceCriteria: parseReviewOutput extracts result, dimensions, reviewReport, selfReviewNotes from untyped output with safe defaults
PASS result renders green banner with checkmark icon, 'All checks passed', and dimension pass ratio
FAIL result renders red banner with X icon, 'N issues found', and FAIL dimension names joined by ' · '
Unknown/null result renders gray banner with 'Review required'
FAIL dimensions render as expanded cards with red dot + dimension name + bullet-point issues
PASS dimensions render as collapsed single line with checkmark + names joined by ' · '
Missing dimensions with FAIL result shows 'Issues found. View full report for details.'
Missing dimensions with PASS result shows 'All checks passed'
Component is pure display — no mutations, no API calls
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Create ReviewApprovalPanel component with Action Area and Full Report Modal
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/web/src/components/ReviewApprovalPanel.tsx` that renders: (1) `<ReviewSummary>` for display; (2) result-dependent Action Area — PASS: single green 'Approve & Done' button + 'View Report →' and 'View Files →' links; FAIL: 'Send back for fixes' (red, sends structured issue summary via sendMessage), 'Add instructions...' (expandable textarea + send), 'Approve anyway' (gray, single-click approve, no confirmation); unknown: 'Approve & Continue' (blue) + 'Send back with notes...' textarea; (3) Full Report Modal (fixed overlay, 80% width, react-markdown rendered, Escape/backdrop/close close). Send-back uses fallback chain: dimensions → Fix Suggestions extraction from reviewReport → generic message. Props: output, issueNumber, onViewFiles, rebaseResult, onRebase, rebasePending. Uses `useSendMessage` and `useMutation({ mutationFn: () => api.approveIssue(issueNumber) })` internally.
acceptanceCriteria: Imports and renders ReviewSummary component
PASS action area: single green 'Approve & Done' button calling approve API, 'View Report →' link, 'View Files →' link calling onViewFiles
FAIL action area: 'Send back for fixes' red button, 'Add instructions...' expandable textarea with 'Send with instructions', 'Approve anyway' gray button
'Send back for fixes' extracts FAIL dimensions and sends 'Please fix the following issues:\n\n' + formatted summary via sendMessage
'Send back for fixes' falls back to Fix Suggestions extraction from reviewReport when dimensions unavailable
'Send back for fixes' falls back to generic message when neither dimensions nor reviewReport available
'Send back for fixes' shows loading state during API call, restores on error
'Approve anyway' executes approve on single click with no confirmation dialog
'Add instructions...' toggle expands/collapses textarea; send button disabled when textarea empty
'Add instructions' send includes user text + FAIL dimension issues summary
Unknown result action area: 'Approve & Continue' blue button + 'Send back with notes...' expandable textarea
Full Report Modal opens on 'View Report →' click: fixed overlay, 80% width, backdrop click/Escape/close button closes it
Modal renders reviewReport via react-markdown, shows 'No detailed report available' if missing
Modal shows selfReviewNotes as fallback when reviewReport is empty
Modal close preserves panel state (textarea content, expand states)
Rebase section renders when rebaseResult or rebasePending props provided
API errors display in panel without clearing state
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Integrate ReviewApprovalPanel into IssueDetailPage
tasks.description: Edit `packages/cli/web/src/components/IssueDetailPage.tsx` to conditionally render `<ReviewApprovalPanel>` when issue is in Review stage approval gate (`isApprovalGate && issue.stage === Stage.Review`). Replace the three old sections (Review Report L781-791, Approval Required L794-889, Send Message L891-926) for Review stage only. Pass required props: output, issueNumber, onViewFiles (sets diffTab to 'files'), rebaseResult, onRebase, rebasePending. Plan stage and other stages keep existing approval UI unchanged. Remove the `reviewOutput` computed variable and `messageText`/`setMessageText` state if they become unused after refactor.
acceptanceCriteria: ReviewApprovalPanel renders when isApprovalGate && stage === Stage.Review
Old Review Report div (L781-791) does NOT render for Review stage approval gate
Old Approval Required div (L794-889) does NOT render for Review stage approval gate
Old Send Message div (L891-926) does NOT render for Review stage approval gate
Plan stage approval gate still renders original 'Approve & Continue' button and Send Message textarea
ReviewApprovalPanel receives correct props: output, issueNumber, onViewFiles, rebaseResult, onRebase, rebasePending
onViewFiles callback sets diffTab to 'files' to switch to Files tab
Build and typecheck pass with no errors
No unused imports or state variables remain after refactor
